hero.heading: A shared home for fire weather social science
hero.body: The Firehouse centralizes the needs and recommendations learned across completed fire weather research, so forecasters, researchers, and decision-makers can find what's already known — and add to it.

stats.label: For submissions
stats.caption: Researchers can contribute findings any time

topicSection.heading: The top 5 needs in fire weather social science
topicSection.body: Forecasters, land managers, and emergency managers keep telling researchers what they need. Here, every completed fire weather social science project in The Firehouse is read together as one body of evidence, and the needs its researchers recorded are distilled into the five most pressing in each of four topic areas — in one place, ranked, with how often each one came up.

submitBand.heading: Have a finding to share?
submitBand.body: Describe what you learned in your own words. Submissions are reviewed and folded into the four topic areas above.
